## Prism 17 - Zoho Push (approval-gated campaign write)
POST /webhook/prism-zoho-push with {campaignId, approvalNotes, tenant context}. Verifies campaign status=Approved server-side (Supabase) before any write, resolves per-connector context (CRM/Projects/Books), then creates Deal -> Project -> Invoice idempotently (existing deal_id/project_id/invoice_id are skipped), saves the new IDs back on the campaign row and writes an agent_audit_logs entry. Partial failures are reported per system and are safe to retry.
